verification.notes: Status transition to in-force as of 2026-09-02 confirmed on 2026-09-14 against the NHC/SAMR announcement chain and a preserved local primary PDF. Local primary PDF: /Volumes/HMI-Library/Regulatory documents/China_GB-2762-2025_2025_Contaminant-MLs.pdf SHA-256 85ed0aa521c66e622fa6af20351a348f8862778ae63d3de56f7cbe26a9f90f80. Instrument remains china-gb-2762-2025-contaminants (amendment of existing row; no second mint). No 2025 numerical values are recorded in this event ledger. 2026-09-14: successor page regulations/china-gb-2762-2025-contaminants created and GB 2762-2022 marked superseded (effective 2026-09-02). 13 GB 2762-2022 register rows superseded by value-identical china_gb2762_2025_* rows; dried-meat Pb/Cd/As/Cr change verified as an application-principle change (removal from the dehydration-conversion rule), not a numeric-cell change, so no new numeric ML row was invented. events.summary: GB 2762-2025 replaced GB 2762-2022 on 2 September 2026 and is now in force for foods placed on the Chinese market. Metal-relevant text changes include revised dried-meat-product rows for Pb, Cd, As, and Cr; numerical maximum levels are not duplicated here and remain queued for regulatory_limit row extraction.
gaps: Dried-meat-product Pb/Cd/As/Cr change resolved 2026-09-14: it is an application-principle change (dried meat products removed from the dehydration-conversion rule; the unchanged general meat-products category MLs now apply directly), not a new numeric cell. events.title: FSANZ A1329 / F2026L01125 varies Schedule 19 cadmium rules for NT-farmed Blacklip Rock oysters

official_sources.title: Food Standards (Application A1329 – Exclusion of Blacklip Rock oysters farmed in the Northern Territory from the ML for cadmium in molluscs) Variation (F2026L01125)
Federal Register of Legislation record F2026L01125

verification.notes: Authorised Federal Register PDF deposited locally. Local primary PDF: /Volumes/HMI-Library/Regulatory documents/AustraliaNZ_F2026L01125_A1329_Cd-Blacklip-Rock-Oysters_2026.pdf SHA-256 59333106aeeee27490405c3f4bb978b83464b0ba11a004e787b653e3350567b6. Item [1] excludes NT-farmed Saccostrea spathulata from the general molluscs Cd row from gazettal day (2026-09-01 / FSC 192). Item [2] inserts a commodity-specific Cd ML of 3 (Schedule 19 units) commencing about 2028-09-02 (day after 24 months from gazettal). Register-update against existing Schedule 19 page only; shellfish corpus pages remain PARKED. events.summary: F2026L01125 (Application A1329) amends Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code Schedule 19 cadmium rules for Northern Territory-farmed Blacklip Rock oysters: exclusion from the general molluscs cadmium row from gazettal on 1 September 2026, with a commodity-specific cadmium maximum level of 3 (Schedule 19 units) commencing about 2 September 2028.
